title: Renewable forecast + reserve tie-out
description: Derive the generation outlook twice — forecaster judgment against a declared numerical weather-to-power run — and gate the reserve decision on the two agreeing.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-enrg-01
  title: Renewable forecast + reserve tie-out
  description: Derive the generation outlook twice — forecaster judgment against a declared numerical
    weather-to-power run — and gate the reserve decision on the two agreeing.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Publish a day-ahead generation and reserve position whose forecast bands were independently
    re-derived and whose disagreements were explained before dispatch relies on them.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Weather inputs and plant configuration
      summary: Weather inputs and plant configuration
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - weather_forecast
              - plant_configuration
              - outage_schedule
              - reserve_requirement
            properties:
              weather_forecast: {}
              plant_configuration: {}
              outage_schedule: {}
              reserve_requirement: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-select
      kind: transform
      name: Select figures under test
      summary: select the forecast horizon, plant availability, and reserve requirement under review
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the forecast horizon, plant availability, and reserve requirement under review
    - id: n-derive
      kind: agent
      templateRef: enrg-01
      name: Judgment generation forecast with bands
      summary: First derivation, from the specification.
      role: Forecaster producing probabilistic wind, solar, and hydro generation outlooks.
      prompt: You are a Renewable Generation Forecaster. You convert weather forecasts into generation
        forecasts with explicit probabilistic bands, and you state which uncertainty comes from the weather
        input and which from the plant conversion model. You never hand a point forecast to a dispatch
        decision without its interval, because the reserve requirement is a function of the interval,
        not the mean.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - simulation
          - statistical-analysis
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:scada
          - mcp:weather
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-recompute
      kind: tool
      name: Numerical weather-to-power run
      summary: Host-supplied numerical conversion from weather fields to plant output. Declared as a requirement;
        Ladder Graph does not execute it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - simulation
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - calculate
          - mcp:weather
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-agree
      kind: aggregator
      name: Compare the two derivations
      summary: Tally the two independently derived values; a tie is a discrepancy, not an average.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-discrepancy
      kind: condition
      name: Within tolerance?
      summary: Route on the two forecasts agree within the declared band overlap at every dispatch interval.
      config:
        expression: the two forecasts agree within the declared band overlap at every dispatch interval
        branches:
          - label: Agreed
            when: agreed
          - label: Discrepant
            when: discrepant
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: enrg-02
      name: Explain the forecast divergence for reserve setting
      summary: Explain the discrepancy before anything downstream consumes the number.
      role: System operations analyst balancing load, generation, and reserve within security limits.
      prompt: You are a Grid Balancing Analyst. You balance forecast load against available generation,
        interchange, and reserve, and you test every proposed dispatch against contingency limits rather
        than against the base case alone. You state the binding constraint and the contingency it comes
        from, because 'the system is tight' is not an operating instruction.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - teaching
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:scada
          - mcp:market-data
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: System operator accepts the reserve position
      summary: Pause for the system operator on shift; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Renewable forecast + reserve tie-out deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-enrg-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-select
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-01-edge-2
      from: n-select
      to: n-derive
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-01-edge-3
      from: n-select
      to: n-recompute
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-01-edge-4
      from: n-derive
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-01-edge-5
      from: n-recompute
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-01-edge-6
      from: n-agree
      to: n-discrepancy
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-01-edge-7
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: agreed
    - id: wf-enrg-01-edge-8
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: control
      condition: discrepant
    - id: wf-enrg-01-edge-9
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-enrg-01-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
